_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffees" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "roaster" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "paid_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "rating" REAL NULL, "roast_level" TEXT NULL, "flavor_profile" TEXT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "is_decaf" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_decaf" IN (0, 1)), "shop_url" TEXT NULL, "rest_days" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffee_components" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coffee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffees (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, "region" TEXT NULL, "farm" TEXT NULL, "producer" TEXT NULL, "variety" TEXT NULL, "process" TEXT NULL, "altitude_meters" INTEGER NULL, "harvest" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("coffee_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffee_lots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coffee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffees (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "roast_date" TEXT NULL, "purchase_date" TEXT NULL, "opened_date" TEXT NULL, "initial_grams" REAL NULL, "remaining_grams" REAL NULL, "overdraw_grams" REAL NULL, "frozen_pause_days" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "frozen_portions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffee_lots (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "container" TEXT NULL, "frozen_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "initial_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "remaining_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "thawed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("label"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_methods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "template_type" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "machine" TEXT NULL, "machine_address" TEXT NULL, "vessel_name" TEXT NULL, "vessel_grams" REAL NULL, "pour_plan_json" TEXT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "grinders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "has_adjustable_rpm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_adjustable_rpm" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "gh_ppm_as_caco3" REAL NULL, "kh_ppm_as_caco3" REAL NULL, "tds_ppm" REAL NULL, "ph" REAL NULL, "calcium_ppm" REAL NULL, "magnesium_ppm" REAL NULL, "sodium_ppm" REAL NULL, "potassium_ppm" REAL NULL, "chloride_ppm" REAL NULL, "sulfate_ppm" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "method_tools" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "method_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES brew_methods (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "merged_into_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES method_tools (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tool_method_links" ("tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES method_tools (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "method_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brew_methods (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY ("tool_id", "method_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brews" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coffee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffees (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "lot_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES coffee_lots (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "method_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES brew_methods (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "grinder_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES grinders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "water_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES water_profiles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "water_profile_name" TEXT NULL, "is_pre_ground" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pre_ground" IN (0, 1)), "method_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "grinder_name" TEXT NULL, "grind_setting" TEXT NULL, "dose_grams" REAL NULL, "water_grams" REAL NULL, "beverage_grams" REAL NULL, "time_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "temperature_c" REAL NULL, "tds_percent" REAL NULL, "grind_rpm" INTEGER NULL, "pressure_bar" REAL NULL, "preinfusion_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "bloom_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "bloom_count" INTEGER NULL, "pour_count" INTEGER NULL, "pour_phases_json" TEXT NULL, "first_drip_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "taste_balance" INTEGER NULL, "taste_strength" INTEGER NULL, "acidity" INTEGER NULL, "sweetness" INTEGER NULL, "bitterness" INTEGER NULL, "body" INTEGER NULL, "aftertaste" INTEGER NULL, "profile_name" TEXT NULL, "rating" REAL NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "brewed_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "archived_by_coffee" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("archived_by_coffee" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_curves" ("brew_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brews (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "samples_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("brew_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffee_photos" ("coffee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffees (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("coffee_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_photos" ("brew_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brews (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("brew_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_tool_selections" ("brew_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brews (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES method_tools (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY ("brew_id", "tool_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_entity" TEXT NULL, "local_id" TEXT NULL, "imported_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("source", "kind", "external_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_payloads" ("import_record_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_records (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "raw_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("import_record_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_preferences" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "share_fields_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "hidden_brew_fields_json" TEXT NULL, "rate_reminder_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "locale_code" TEXT NULL, "last_backup_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "scale_device_id" TEXT NULL, "scale_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
